'''''X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Aaron Allston]]. It is the ninth volume of the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] novel series, and it was first published by [[Bantam Spectra]] on [[August 3]], [[1999]]. The novel also received an [[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar (abridged audiobook)|abridged audiobook]] version that was released in [[2007]].
